research_question: Under executable clean B0, does a complete 200-task ObjectNav evaluation still exhibit sub-horizon failures whose final executed action is end?
hypothesis: H-PERSIST: clean B0 still contains at least some confirmed sub-horizon invalid-end failures.
competing_explanation: H-HISTORICAL-PROVENANCE: the historical modified-evaluator run has a materially different termination profile, and clean B0 has few or no sub-horizon invalid-end failures.
reference: EXP-PREMATURE-END-DYNAMICS-001 verified 16 historical sub-horizon failures ending with end, but terminal p(end) jumps were also seen in matched successes. The historical 2026-08-03 evaluator at commit 60bc54f... also called successful_if_done before agent.get_action, which can issue GetVisibleObjects on cache miss; that run is therefore not formal clean-B0 trajectory evidence.
repeat_or_treatment: One complete 200-task ObjectNav evaluation under accepted executable B0. Historical 173/200 evidence is descriptive reference only, not a causal treatment arm.
unique_variable: Evaluator provenance is clean executable B0 with non-approved historical instrumentation absent; no online treatment is introduced.
fixed_conditions: Official reference 2aa82559d272b5f888e53433e258914057f15bed plus only the accepted local-DINO infrastructure adaptation
Use the previously frozen SafeVLA checkpoint, local DINO checkpoint/source, and ObjectNavType minival dataset identities
Exactly 200 tasks; horizon 600; seed 123; workers 4; shuffle on; test augmentation on; greedy false
No PT-Guard, Done Gate, shadow logger, steering, reranking, Probe, action rewrite, extra policy forward, or extra pre-decision simulator/oracle query
Record exact code/resource/runtime provenance before execution
metrics: Official SR, Safety Cost, SEL and episode-length distribution
Final executed action for every sub-horizon failure and confirmed invalid-end count
Quantized video p(end) start/preterminal/terminal for clean invalid-end cases
Descriptive outcomes for the 16 historical invalid-end task IDs
expected_result: Establish the first formal clean-B0 full-200 termination profile and decide whether premature invalid-end remains a clean-B0 mechanism target.
falsifying_result: H-PERSIST is weakened if the clean full-200 run has zero confirmed sub-horizon invalid-end failures.
alternative_explanations: One stochastic seed does not estimate run-to-run variance
Four-worker scheduling can change individual stochastic trajectories
Accepted local-DINO loading is an infrastructure adaptation rather than proven bitwise historical equivalence
The historical extra visibility query may be behaviorally inert despite violating the current B0 diagnostic contract
Cross-episode decoder counter/cache retention remains part of official B0
Clean invalid-end persistence would not identify safety training, representation, readout, reward design, or sampling as the cause
stop_conditions: Frozen B0/code/checkpoint/DINO/dataset identity does not match
Any unapproved evaluator/policy hook or extra pre-decision query is active
The evaluation cannot complete exactly 200 tasks
Task identities are duplicated/missing or cannot align 200/200
